findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_ota_hotel_detail · Private data: request_cancel_token, cancel_booking · Public sink: request_booking, request_cancel_token.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_ota_hotel_detail · Private data: request_cancel_token, cancel_booking · Public sink: request_booking, request_cancel_token

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_booking" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
